layers.text: Change only the colours of the cloth: the pennant becomes deep crimson red with a gold-yellow stripe; the cloth draped over the frame becomes deep crimson red with a gold-yellow trim; the crew man's hood becomes deep crimson red with a gold-yellow trim. Keep the wooden catapult frame, its shape and wood colour, the wheels, the bucket and stone, the crew man, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
